title: U and H and the space bar
summary: The two keys with bumps, the space bar, and the habit of not looking down.
intro: The keys with a small bump are where everything starts. Both index fingers rest there and do not wander; the rest of the course is measured from that position. Start by placing both hands and looking only at the screen.
congrats: Your hands are in place. From here on, everything is a key you reach from this position and let go of again.

screens.text: This key belongs to your left index finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only U and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.

screens.text: The space bar belongs to your right thumb. The thumbs do nothing else, which is why you never have to look for it.
screens.hint: Press the space bar to continue

screens.text: Short groups with spaces between them. The right thumb goes down and up; every other finger stays put.
